# Miro boards

Connect your own Miro account and choose a team. This app uses only `boards:read` and `boards:write`, which Miro makes available on all plans. Your board permissions and team installation policies still apply. A host-managed OAuth client is the default; entering your own OAuth client or a team access token remains an advanced fallback.

The tool surface covers boards, board membership and board content. Organization and team administration, board exports, audit logs, legal holds, SCIM, session resets and app-management APIs are excluded. Reads do not ask for approval; every mutation does.

The app uses the official [Miro API specification](https://github.com/miroapp/api-clients/blob/39161f97cee3f887f5f67cf4a003ce93b3a6903b/packages/generator/spec.json) at a fixed commit. Its exclusion list is bound to that document. Miro's [scope matrix](https://developers.miro.com/reference/scopes) documents the plan boundary. This source does not use Miro's Web SDK or hosted MCP server.

import type { OpenapiToolNamesOptions } from "apps/openapi";

// The pinned document has no per-operation OAuth scopes. Keep only board paths, excluding
// organization/team administration, exports, audit, SCIM, session resets and app management.

export const options = {
  source: {
    url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miroapp/api-clients/39161f97cee3f887f5f67cf4a003ce93b3a6903b/packages/generator/spec.json",
  },
  allowedOrigin: "https://api.miro.com",
  securitySchemes: { oAuth2AuthCode: { type: "http", scheme: "bearer" } },
  fallbackSecurity: [{ oAuth2AuthCode: [] }],
  methods: {
    token: [{ scheme: "oAuth2AuthCode", field: "token", part: "value", prefix: "" }],
    oauth: [{ scheme: "oAuth2AuthCode", field: "access_token", part: "value", prefix: "" }],
  },
  oauth: [],
  patches: excludedPaths.map((path) => ({
    op: "remove" as const,
    path: `/paths/${path.replace(/~/g, "~0").replace(/\//g, "~1")}`,
  })),
} satisfies OpenapiToolNamesOptions;
